title: A user without the Manager or Office User role does not see the Parts Velocity navigation entry
custom_preconds: 1. You are signed in as a user whose role is neither Manager nor Office User (a role without access to the Reports section).
custom_steps:
1. Look at the application's main navigation.
2. Try to find the Reports section and the Parts Velocity entry.
custom_expected:
1. The user cannot reach the Reports section.
2. The Parts Velocity navigation entry is not shown (this is the Reports section's own access control, not a report-specific rule).
